scenario: A speeding commercial truck rammed into my father's two-wheeler at an intersection in Pune. He suffered multiple fractures and the driver fled the spot without providing medical help.

My brother was fatally injured in a hit-and-run accident on the highway near Jaipur by an unidentified white SUV. The vehicle could not be traced. What immediate compensation and relief can our family claim?

A private cab driver rear-ended my car at a traffic signal. The driver admits fault but says his insurance policy expired two weeks ago. How do I recover vehicle repair costs and medical expenses from the owner?

A pedestrian college student was knocked down on a zebra crossing by an over-speeding motorcyclist doing stunts. The student suffered permanent physical disability. Which tribunal handles the compensation?

The local state transport bus collided with an auto-rickshaw carrying passengers. The auto driver died on the spot. The deceased was the sole earning member leaving behind elderly parents and two minor children.
A delivery boy on a company-owned scooter hit an elderly morning walker causing head trauma. The delivery company claims they are not liable because the rider is an independent gig contractor.
An overloaded dumper truck overturned on a passenger car at an underpass in Greater Noida. The car driver sustained severe spinal trauma and loss of future earning capacity as a software engineer.

A luxury sedan jumped a red signal at night and crashed into three stationary motorcycles. The driver was visibly intoxicated. Police registered an FIR but the driver is attempting to settle informally without insurance.
critical_steps: MACT claim against driver and insurer

scenario: My mother was boarding a city transit bus when the conductor signaled the driver to start before she entered completely. She fell under the rear wheel and fractured her pelvis. The transport corporation refuses liability.

A minor driving his father's SUV caused a serious collision injuring two school children. The father says the son took the keys without permission. Who pays the compensation and does insurance cover this?

An accident occurred involving an out-of-state registered lorry on the national highway in Maharashtra. The vehicle owner lives in Rajasthan. Which court has territorial jurisdiction for filing our compensation claim?
critical_steps: File at place of accident or claimant residence under S.166(2)

scenario: A car rammed into a roadside tea stall destroying the shop structure and injuring the vendor and a customer. Can property damage and loss of business livelihood be claimed before the MACT?
A school bus overturned due to rash driving on a sharp curve. Several students received grievous injuries. The bus had no valid fitness certificate or speed governor installed.
critical_steps: FIR against school management and driver

scenario: A pedestrian was hit by an electric two-wheeler riding on the wrong side of a one-way road. The rider fled into an alley. The injured party needs immediate emergency medical relief under the Motor Vehicles Act.
The insurance company repudiated a third-party fatal accident claim before the MACT arguing that the deceased was traveling as a gratuitous passenger in a goods carrier vehicle.

I bought a residential plot in Delhi via General Power of Attorney (GPA) and agreement to sell in 2018. Now the seller's legal heirs have occupied the land and claim my GPA sale is legally void under Suraj Lamp judgment.

Our residential tenant in Bangalore stopped paying rent 8 months ago and refuses to vacate despite our lease agreement having expired. He threatens us with criminal complaints if we disconnect electricity.

My neighbor started constructing a multi-story balcony extending directly over our private residential driveway, blocking our sunlight and vehicle access. Can we obtain an immediate injunction from the court?

A builder executed a registered agreement to sell an apartment to me with 30% advance paid. He now demands 40% extra citing rising raw material costs, or threatens to cancel the deed and sell to a third party.
critical_steps: Suit for specific performance of contract

scenario: While I was working abroad in Dubai for two years, distant relatives broke the locks of my ancestral bungalow in Kerala and occupied it. Can I recover possession summarily without fighting a 10-year title trial?
critical_steps: File summary suit under Section 6 SRA within 6 months of dispossession

scenario: My uncle forged my deceased grandmother's signature on a gift deed transferring 4 acres of ancestral farmland exclusively into his name, excluding my mother who is a legal co-heir.
critical_steps: Suit for cancellation of forged gift deed

scenario: A commercial landlord in Gurgaon forcefully padlocked my restaurant overnight during a lease renewal dispute, confiscating Rs. 25 lakhs worth of commercial kitchen equipment without serving any notice.

Three co-owners inherited a commercial shopping complex. Two brothers want to sell the entire property to a mall developer, but the sister refuses to sell her undivided 1/3rd share. What is the remedy?
critical_steps: Suit for partition by metes and bounds

scenario: The adjoining land owner has started excavating a deep basement right next to our boundary wall, causing deep cracks to appear in our foundation and risking immediate structural collapse.
critical_steps: Immediate ex-parte ad-interim injunction under Order 39

scenario: I entered into an unwritten oral lease for an agricultural orchard in Punjab paying 3 years rent in advance. The landlord has now harvested the fruits and barred my farm workers from entering.
critical_steps: Suit for declaration of tenancy rights and damages

scenario: A housing society management committee has unlawfully sealed the clubhouse and terrace access for ground-floor flat owners claiming they do not pay higher maintenance charges.
We paid token earnest money of Rs. 10 lakhs for buying a villa. Before executing the sale deed, we discovered that the property was already mortgaged to a public sector bank under SARFAESI Act.
critical_steps: Suit for recovery of earnest money with interest

scenario: A public utility department erected an electrical transformer box directly inside our private residential compound without initiating land acquisition proceedings or paying any compensation.
A buyer backed out of a registered sale agreement after 6 months claiming market prices crashed, and now demands refund of non-refundable earnest deposit. Can the seller forfeit the token money?
An encroachment gang erected tin sheds and cattle fencing overnight on our vacant plot in the outskirts of Hyderabad. Can we approach the court for an ex-parte stay order?
critical_steps: Police complaint for criminal trespass under BNS 329
Suit for permanent injunction with ad-interim stay

scenario: I ordered an Apple iPhone 15 Pro worth Rs. 1,35,000 from a major e-commerce marketplace. The delivery package arrived containing two soap bars instead of the phone. Customer support refuses to refund or investigate.

A prominent real estate developer in Noida promised delivery of our residential apartment by December 2021. Even after 4 years of delay and paying 95% of the total flat cost, possession has not been offered. Can we seek full refund with interest under Experion Developers ruling?
critical_steps: Consumer complaint for refund with interest

scenario: I purchased a brand new electric car. Within 15 days of delivery, the battery caught fire while charging, completely gutting the vehicle and burning my garage. The manufacturer claims user charging negligence.
critical_steps: Automobile product liability action under S.84
Consumer complaint for full vehicle replacement and damages

scenario: A private health insurance company rejected my father's legitimate cashless bypass surgery claim of Rs. 6.5 lakhs, falsely asserting suppression of pre-existing hypertension, even though the policy was active for 6 years.
An airline cancelled our connecting international flight from Mumbai to London without prior notice or providing alternative accommodations, causing us to miss a cruise tour worth Rs. 4 lakhs.
A five-star hospital administered an expired antibiotic injection to a patient leading to septic shock and emergency ICU admission for 10 days. The hospital refuses to waive the exorbitant ICU bill.

A coaching institute charged Rs. 1,80,000 as lump-sum advance tuition fees for a two-year IIT-JEE entrance program. My son withdrew after one month due to severe illness, but the institute refused any fee refund.
critical_steps: CCPA coaching fee refund guidelines notice

scenario: An authorized automobile service center replaced my car's engine oil with counterfeit contaminated oil, resulting in total engine seizure within 50 kilometers of servicing.
critical_steps: Consumer complaint for deficiency & product liability

scenario: A commercial bank debited Rs. 75,000 from my savings account via an unauthorized UPI transaction originating from another state while I had my physical SIM in possession. The bank failed to block the transaction despite immediate 1-hour intimation.
A food delivery platform delivered a mutton dish to a strictly vegetarian family that had ordered paneer curry. The family members suffered acute food poisoning due to contaminated food.
critical_steps: Order invoice and food delivery photos
Consumer complaint for product liability and religious hurt

scenario: An online travel portal booked flight tickets and confirmed payment, but at the airport the airline stated the PNR was never ticketed by the portal. We were forced to purchase last-minute tickets at 4x the price.
critical_steps: Consumer claim for fare difference and mental agony

scenario: A manufacturer of infant baby formula sold batches past the expiry date with manipulated relabeled date stickers. Several babies in our society developed acute gastroenteritis.
critical_steps: Class action complaint to CCPA under S.10

scenario: A telecom service provider activated unsolicited international roaming value-added services without user consent and generated a bill of Rs. 1,12,000, disconnecting outgoing services upon dispute.
critical_steps: Consumer complaint for unfair trade practice

scenario: A water purifier company installed a commercial RO filter in our clinic with a 3-year comprehensive warranty. The machine broke down after 2 months and service technicians haven't visited in 60 days.

A dry cleaning franchise ruined an imported designer bridal lehenga worth Rs. 3,50,000 by using wrong chemical solvents, and offers only Rs. 1,000 compensation under a fine-print clause on the receipt.
critical_steps: Receipt showing unconscionable limitation of liability
Consumer complaint for full value compensation

Write a 500-word creative essay on the beauty of sunsets on the beaches of Goa for my high school english literature class.
